name: codeflow-viewer
//type: Deliberately absent. It would silence node's reparse warning for the .ts tests, and it also flips esbuild to node-ESM interop: `__toESM(require_cytoscape_elk())` becomes `__toESM(..., 1)`, which makes `default` the whole module.exports rather than the extension function inside it. `cytoscape.use` would then be handed an object, on a page no unit test loads. A warning is cheaper than that.
description: Tooling for the interactive viewer: vendored browser libraries and the JS tests. The Kotlin build does not depend on any of this.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:bundle && node --test app/src/test/js/unit/*.test.ts
